facts.fact: 控制台灯灭后，Leah 屏住呼吸整整六十秒，并在这一分钟内想到自己被取出的肺
facts.anchor: When the console lights went off, I held my breath for a full sixty seconds

facts.fact: 按规程应立刻发求救信号，但求救依赖系统在线，而他们的系统已断
facts.anchor: sending a distress call relies on your system being online, which ours was not

facts.fact: Matteo 在通讯台前把手在控制台上移动片刻，然后看向 Leah
facts.anchor: Matteo at the comms panel, moving his hands over the console for a moment and then looking at me

facts.fact: Matteo 逐一检查了引擎、接线盒与压力表，判断设备本身没有故障
facts.anchor: Matteo was the one who checked the engines, the junction boxes, the pressure gauges

facts.fact: 失电后艇在她眼里不再像精密工程，而像一只正在快速下沉的箱子
facts.anchor: less a piece of precision-tooled engineering and more a swiftly sinking box

facts.fact: 系统失效时艇仍在下降，且已深到无法撤离
facts.anchor: We were still descending when the system went out and already too deep to evacuate

facts.fact: CO2 吸收器侥幸完好，但压载水舱无法控制，全员只能继续下沉
facts.anchor: with no way to control the ballast tanks, there was nothing we could do but continue to drop

relations.kind: 同艇乘员：故障后他查设备、她观察他，二人以目光互相确认
relations.anchor: I remember Matteo at the comms panel

relations.kind: 以肺的意象自持：她把屏息的一分钟都用来想象肺被从背后扯出仍在胀缩
relations.anchor: considered the wet wing shapes of my lungs

relations.kind: 他判定系统「理应正常」，与全艇断电断讯的现实相反
relations.anchor: it should all be working fine

relations.kind: 下沉中的艇已越过可撤离深度，深度剥夺了逃生选项

numbers.value: 六十秒（系统死亡到重新吸气之间的时长）
numbers.anchor: the sixty seconds between the system dying and the next breath
